ModMetaData.name: Colonist Pride
ModMetaData.author: Gemdave
ModMetaData.description:
Colonists take pride in the fine work they create — and feel it when that work is lost.
Colonist Pride adds mood effects tied to the quality of items your colonists craft:
- Pride: crafting an Excellent, Masterwork, or Legendary item gives the maker a mood boost, scaling with quality. - Heartbreak: losing a high-quality item the pawn once made brings a mood penalty. - Relief: losing low-quality item they made brings a small mood boost. After all no one misses their worst work.
Only affects items still owned by the colony, made by pawns still with you.
Requires Harmony.
